messages_mbpp.content:
Write the Python function described below. You may run code to check it. End with the complete Python code in a fenced block.

Write a function to find the occurrence and position of the substrings within a string. Return None if there is no match.
Your code should pass this test:
assert occurance_substring('python programming, python language','python')==('python', 0, 6)

function.name: python
function.description: Run Python 3 code in a sandbox with no network, no files and no installs, and get its stdout and stderr. print() what you need; the value of a final bare expression is printed too.
